params.interpretation: attributable_m is an UPPER BOUND on avoidable motion under perfect foresight (observed minus the optimal tour of the same visit set). It is not a target, not a forecast and not a savings estimate. Report it as 'at most N% of observed walking was attributable to visit ordering, under perfect foresight', never as 'we could save N% of walking' (SPEC-003, 'Defining waste honestly').
necessary_m_methods: exact: Held-Karp subset DP over free-endpoint Hamiltonian paths
uncertainty_sources: episode-derivation parameter sensitivity (SPEC-002 min_dwell_s sweep, one-sided: it can drop episodes a stricter threshold would have lost, not recover ones a looser threshold would have found)
